
            <h1 class="postTitle">
                <a id="cb_post_title_url" class="postTitle2 vertical-middle" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/DashVector/p/19702205" title="发布于 2026-03-11 14:27">
    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">如何通过Java SDK删除Partition</span>
    

</a>

            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                <div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body cnblogs-markdown">
<p>本文介绍如何通过Java SDK删除Collection中一个已存在的Partition。</p>
<p><strong>重要</strong></p>
<p>删除Partition后，该Partition所有数据将删除且不可恢复，请谨慎操作。</p>
<h2 id="前提条件">前提条件</h2>
<ul>
<li>
<p>已创建Cluster：<a href="https://help.aliyun.com/zh/document_detail/2631966.html" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">创建Cluster</a>。</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>已获得API-KEY：<a href="https://help.aliyun.com/zh/document_detail/2510230.html" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">API-KEY管理</a>。</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>已安装最新版SDK：<a href="https://help.aliyun.com/zh/document_detail/2510231.html" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">安装DashVector SDK</a>。</p>
</li>
</ul>
<h2 id="接口定义">接口定义</h2>
<p>Java</p>
<pre><code>// class DashVectorCollection

public Response&lt;Void&gt; deletePartition(String name);
</code></pre>
<h2 id="使用示例"><strong>使用示例</strong></h2>
<p><strong>说明</strong></p>
<ol>
<li>
<p>需要使用您的api-key替换示例中的YOUR_API_KEY、您的Cluster Endpoint替换示例中的YOUR_CLUSTER_ENDPOINT，代码才能正常运行。</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>本示例需要参考<a href="https://help.aliyun.com/zh/document_detail/2573558.html" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">新建Collection</a>提前创建好名称为<code>quickstart</code>的Collection。</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>本示例需要参考<a href="https://help.aliyun.com/zh/document_detail/2573598.html" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">新建Partition</a>提前创建好名称为<code>shoes</code>的Partition。</p>
</li>
</ol>
<p>Java</p>
<pre><code>import com.aliyun.dashvector.DashVectorClient;
import com.aliyun.dashvector.DashVectorCollection;
import com.aliyun.dashvector.common.DashVectorException;
import com.aliyun.dashvector.models.responses.Response;

public class Main {
    public static void main(String[] args) throws DashVectorException {
        DashVectorClient client = new DashVectorClient("YOUR_API_KEY", "YOUR_CLUSTER_ENDPOINT");
        DashVectorCollection collection = client.get("quickstart");
        
        // 删除名为shoes的Partition
        Response&lt;Void&gt; response = collection.deletePartition("shoes");

        // 判断请求是否成功
        // assert response.isSuccess();
    }
}
</code></pre>
<h2 id="入参描述"><strong>入参描述</strong></h2>
<table>
<thead>
<tr>
<th><strong>参数</strong></th>
<th><strong>类型</strong></th>
<th><strong>必填</strong></th>
<th><strong>默认值</strong></th>
<th><strong>描述</strong></th>
</tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr>
<td>name</td>
<td>String</td>
<td>是</td>
<td>\-</td>
<td>待删除的Partition名称</td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>
<h2 id="出参描述"><strong>出参描述</strong></h2>
<p><strong>说明</strong></p>
<p>返回结果为<code>Response&lt;Void&gt;</code>对象，<code>Response&lt;Void&gt;</code>对象中可获取本次操作结果信息，如下表所示。</p>
<table>
<thead>
<tr>
<th><strong>方法</strong></th>
<th><strong>类型</strong></th>
<th><strong>描述</strong></th>
<th><strong>示例</strong></th>
</tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr>
<td>getCode()</td>
<td>int</td>
<td>返回值，参考<a href="https://help.aliyun.com/zh/document_detail/2510266.html" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">返回状态码说明</a></td>
<td>0</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>getMessasge()</td>
<td>String</td>
<td>返回消息</td>
<td>success</td>
</tr>
<tr>

<td>String</td>

<td>19215409-ea66-4db9-8764-26ce2eb5bb99</td>
</tr>
<tr>

</tr>
